importExport.Name: User Settings
importExport.Label: Import / Export
importExport.Hint: Allows you to import and export custom templates and scripts.

Replace.Title: Replacement
Replace.Hint:
Yes: existing templates will be deleted.
No: new templates will be added to existing ones.

importExport.File: Select the file with the user settings
importExport.Error: Failed to read the settings file. Make sure you selected a valid export file.

Reset.Content: Delete custom templates if they cause errors.
Reset.Hint: Before deleting, it is recommended to save the templates by exporting them to a file.
Reset.Confirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{type}"?

Update.Label: Update Scripts
Update.Hint: Use it if you encounter errors when working with them.
Update.Notify: The Generator Scripts have been updated. This does not apply to scripts in already created items.

modifier.Name: Loot cost modifier
modifier.Hint:
An additional modifier that multiplies the final rolls for found coins and item values.
For example: "2" will double the coins received, while "0.5" will halve them.

sellItems.Name: Quick sale
sellItems.Hint:
Enabled: players can either take found items or exchange them for coins.
Disabled: players can only take found items.
sellItems.Error: The Game Master has disabled quick sale of items.

itemsModifier.Name: Halve item value
itemsModifier.Hint:
Enabled: item value during quick sale is halved.
Disabled: item value during quick sale remains unchanged.
itemsModifier.Tooltip: The cost of the item has been reduced by half for a quick sale.

tokenLootButton.Name: Token looting
tokenLootButton.Hint:
Enabled: hovering over a dead token on the canvas displays a button for quick looting.
Disabled: quick token looting is disabled.

editName.Name: Name editor
editName.Hint:
Enabled: a window will appear when generating an item allowing you to change its name.
Disabled: the generated item's name can be edited after creation.

hideQualities.Name: Hide qualities
hideQualities.Hint:
Enabled: Item Generator templates containing only a single quality are hidden.
Disabled: Item Generator templates containing only a single quality are displayed.

hideEffects.Name: Hide Generator Scripts
hideEffects.Hint:
Enabled: Item Generator scripts are hidden from players. Useful for cursed items.
Disabled: Item Generator scripts are visible to players.

Item.Name: Looting Effects
Item.Description:
This item is needed to store the effects of basic and custom templates.
You can move this item to any folder, rename or modify it, but it will be recreated when deleted.

propsCompatibility.Name: Property compatibility
propsCompatibility.Hint:
Enabled: mutually exclusive properties are removed during Item Generation.
Disabled: all rolled properties are added during Item Generation.
Examples of mutually exclusive properties: "Fine" and "Ugly", "Fast" and "Slow".
